fillInstructions.description: Fill the removed Moana silhouette with the central card’s ocean backdrop: bright turquoise-to-cyan water with flowing, curved wave streaks and soft highlight patches. Reconstruct the water continuously across the former face/torso/hair area so it matches surrounding motion-like swirls. Where the character previously occluded it, continue the wooden oar segment diagonally from lower-left toward upper-right with consistent tan wood grain and lighting, aligned to the visible oar pieces above her head and at her left side.
continueEdges: Continue cyan wave streaks from left interior panel through center-right behind former hair mass.
Extend soft white/aqua water highlights across the chest/face area to match nearby ripple direction.
Maintain the diagonal oar trajectory (bottom-left to top-right) through the removed shoulder/hand zone, preserving width and wood texture continuity.
Keep all reconstruction inside the rounded-rectangle card boundaries and preserve existing border edge contrast.
fillInstructions.texture: Medium-detail aquatic texture with layered painterly swirls, subtle blur gradients, and speckled light reflections; smooth, fibrous wood grain on the oar.
